notes.title: SEASON 2
notes.content:
Hey folks!

Hope you had a wondering adventure in season one. 
At friday 12 November we will release season two to IMH. This means that your character in season one will be wiped and a new season will begin with other modifiers than in season one.

We assume those seasons to be about 2 months but it could change, However we will inform you about a new upcomming season a week before releasing it (give or take)

Thank you for playing IMH
Happy hunting adventurer!

Greenblade Studios
